description: Get an indicative price for a published tour from list_tours (one with status "bookable"), for a number of adults, two sharing a room or each in a single room. It uses the same engine as the Follow On Tours website checkout, for the cheapest available ticket and room, and returns the total and the price per person in the tour currency, with the hotel, ticket and nights it is based on. Quote it exactly as returned, as an indicative price: nothing is held or booked, and the price on the traveller’s own quote is the one that applies. It takes no personal details and sends nothing. For another hotel, extra nights, breakfast, transfers, or any tour priced on request, use request_quote.

match.description: On a tour with several matches (e.g. a five-Test series), which match or venue, in the traveller’s words.

roomType.description: "sharing" = two to a room; "single" = each traveller in their own room.

tour.description: The tour slug or name from list_tours.

name: get_price
